Air density

Source: R/metric-sensible-heat.R
ef_air_density.Rd

Computes the density of moist air \(\rho_{air}\) [kg m-3] from the atmospheric pressure and the air temperature with the ideal-gas form of FAO-56, using the virtual temperature approximation \(T_{Kv} = 1.01\,T\).

Usage

ef_air_density(pressure, air_temperature)

Arguments

pressure

Numeric. Atmospheric pressure \(P\) [kPa] (measured, regionalised or from ef_air_pressure()). Must be finite and > 0.

air_temperature

Numeric. Air temperature \(T\) [K]. Must be finite and > 0. In the METRIC calibration this is the near-surface air temperature \(T_a = T_s - dT\) (decision SH-08).

Value

A numeric vector of air density [kg m-3], with the common length of the inputs and keeping their dim.

Details

$$\rho_{air} = \frac{1000\, P}{1.01\, T\, R}$$ with \(R = 287\) J kg-1 K-1 (specific gas constant of dry air) and the factor 1000 converting kPa to Pa. FAO-56 (chapter 2, box 6) writes \(T_{Kv} = 1.01 (T + 273)\) with \(T\) in degrees Celsius; EarthFlux takes \(T\) in K, which is equivalent to using 273.15 instead of 273 (relative difference about 5e-4; decision SH-08). The normative coefficients 1.01 and 287 are kept as literals of this equation (decision WF-14).

Missing values propagate. Infinite values and values outside the domain raise an error of class earthflux_domain_error (also earthflux_input_error).

Verification status: VERIFICADA as the content of FAO-56 (chapter 2, box 6). Its use in METRIC is CANDIDATA: the SEBAL Idaho manual computes the air density at \(T_a = T_s - dT\) (Waters et al., 2002, p. 31, step 6), which corroborates the temperature used here, but it does not print the density equation (METRIC implementations such as the water package use a variant that evaluates the pressure of the standard atmosphere with \(T_a\) in place of 293 K: the two densities coincide at sea level or at \(T_a\) = 293 K, and the variant is higher above 293 K, by about 0.6 % at 316 K and 700 m).

References

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., & Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements (FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56). FAO, Rome. ISBN 92-5-104219-5.

See also

Other aerodynamics and sensible heat functions: ef_blending_wind(), ef_calibrate_h(), ef_dt_coef(), ef_h_control(), ef_rah(), ef_sensible_heat(), ef_ts_datum(), ef_ustar(), ef_zom()

Examples

# Air at 300 K and 500 m (pressure from elevation)
ef_air_density(ef_air_pressure(500), 300)
#> [1] 1.098511

ef_air_density(pressure = c(95.5276, 93.2947), air_temperature = c(300, 316))
#> [1] 1.098511 1.018513
